Importing libraries:

``` r
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library("ggpubr")
library(plotly)
```

Reading the data file;

``` r
T1 <- read.csv("../data/results_df_2.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
```

Seeing the data file:

``` r
head(T1, 15)%>%
  kbl(caption = "1000 runs results table") %>%
  kable_paper() %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "500px")
```

Visualizing the results for ET:

``` r
fig1 <- T1_et %>%
  plot_ly(
    y = ~Test.MSE,
    type = 'violin',
    box = list(
      visible = T
    ),
    meanline = list(
      visible = T
    ),
    color = I("#241468"),
    x0 = 'Extra Trees Regreesion'
  ) 

fig1 <- fig1 %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Test MSE",
      zeroline = F
    )
  )

fig1
```

``` r

  plot_ly(
    y = ~Test.RMSE,
    type = 'violin',
    box = list(
      visible = T
    ),
    meanline = list(
      visible = T
    ),
    color = I("#EA1179"),
    x0 = 'Extra Trees Regreesion'
  ) 

fig3 <- fig3 %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Test RMSE",
      zeroline = F
    )
  )

fig3
```

``` r

  plot_ly(
    y = ~Test.MAPE,
    type = 'violin',
    box = list(
      visible = T
    ),
    meanline = list(
      visible = T
    ),
    color = I("#F79BD3"),
    x0 = 'Extra Trees Regreesion'
  ) 

fig4 <- fig4 %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Test MAPE",
      zeroline = F
    )
  )

fig4
```
